title: Захват на складе  (Raid at the Warehouse)

segments.t: Armed special forces burst into the abandoned warehouse just as Pavel and his partners finish packing the bribe money into vehicles. Caught completely off guard, the corrupt officials are ordered to the ground and placed under immediate arrest. Let's listen in Russian.
Что здесь происходит? Кто вы такие?
Всем лежать на полу, я сказал!
Никому не двигаться с этого места!
Я буду говорить только с адвокатом.
Let's examine the dialogue step by step. Notice the sharp, imperative military commands and urgent responses used during a police raid.
'Everyone down! Special forces at work!' Impersonal 'to'-form basic verb form command followed by a third person present verb.
Всем лежать на полу, я сказал!
'Everyone down on the floor, I said!' Firm command with an action verb, location phrase on the floor, and a past tense verb.
'Drop weapons! Hands behind head!' Basic verb form command command followed by an object-form location direction phrase.
'Please do not shoot, we surrender!' Polite particle with a negative plural command verb and a self-action verb form verb.
'There is no mistake, you are under arrest!' Negative construction with 'of'-form case followed by a short passive past verbal adjective.
Я буду говорить только с адвокатом.
'I will speak only with a lawyer.' Compound future ongoing-action form tense followed by an 'with'-form noun. Now listen to the full conversation once more at natural conversational speed.
Что здесь происходит? Кто вы такие?
Всем лежать на полу, я сказал!
Никому не двигаться с этого места!
Я буду говорить только с адвокатом.
The raid brings an abrupt end to the corrupt deal as the suspects are detained. See you next time!
